Jordan Grimmer-Tufik Thanks Jordan! Just to clarify, the appointment on the 13th is solely to extend my visa here and not for documents submission or interview.
Our partnership application (submitted June 8th) hasn't been opened yet, as the clerk said when we were there this Sunday (the appointment on the 13th was given to us on the spot). 

Given that our application hasn't been reviewed, do you think it's realistically possible to get an inter visa at the appointment on the 13th with the b2 downgrade? 

Can we use this meeting to pressure them into scheduling an actual file submission or interview date? 
I have my exit and entry log with flight tickets that prove I haven't been in korea for a year, but I'm worried the clerk won't give me an inter visa...
